g.text: Only user-selected H1/H2 mission power and GND pins are connected. Excluded communication/normally-closed pins are not represented here.

g.desc: Only user-selected H1/H2 mission power and GND pins are connected. Excluded communication/normally-closed pins are not represented here.

g.text: Power path on every rail: RAW -> eFuse -> INA260 VIN+ -> INA260 VIN- -> PROTECTED output. INA260 VIN- is the downstream positive rail, never GND.

g.desc: Power path on every rail: RAW -> eFuse -> INA260 VIN+ -> INA260 VIN- -> PROTECTED output. INA260 VIN- is the downstream positive rail, never GND.

g.text: 4-layer PCB intent: L1 components/high-current/local signals, L2 solid GND reference, L3 power zones, L4 secondary routing/GND fill.

g.desc: 4-layer PCB intent: L1 components/high-current/local signals, L2 solid GND reference, L3 power zones, L4 secondary routing/GND fill.

g.text: Serviceable layout choice: eFuse ICs are on the main PCB for manufacturer assembly. For true field replacement, move each eFuse circuit to a plug-in daughterboard.

g.desc: Serviceable layout choice: eFuse ICs are on the main PCB for manufacturer assembly. For true field replacement, move each eFuse circuit to a plug-in daughterboard.
